site.device.disabled.heading.note: Page the bridge shows at a family member's address when the device's owner has disabled that account: the heading.

site.device.disabled.text.text: The owner of this device has disabled this account. Contact them if you believe this is a mistake.
site.device.disabled.text.note: Page the bridge shows at a family member's address when the device's owner has disabled that account: the text under the heading. Them: the device's owner.

site.device.disabled.title.note: Page the bridge shows at a family member's address (name.off-the.cloud) when the device's owner has disabled that account: the page title, in the browser tab.

site.device.unavailable.countdown.note: Page the bridge shows when a device doesn't answer: small line under the Try again button, counting down to the next automatic reload. {seconds} goes from 30 down to 1; the s after it is the abbreviation of seconds (write it as your language abbreviates seconds, with or without a space).

site.device.unavailable.heading.text: This device isn't available right now
site.device.unavailable.heading.note: Page the bridge shows at a device's address when the device doesn't answer (switched off, offline or starting): the heading.

site.device.unavailable.retry.note: Page the bridge shows when a device doesn't answer: button that reloads the page.

site.device.unavailable.text.text: It looks like it's switched off, offline, or still starting up. Nothing has been lost — everything stays on the device itself. Try again in a moment.
site.device.unavailable.text.note: Page the bridge shows at a device's address when the device doesn't answer: the text under the heading.

site.device.unavailable.title.note: Page the bridge shows at a device's address (name.off-the.cloud) when the device doesn't answer: the page title, in the browser tab.
